title: census.py read counts each confirmed source twice in its census.phase row
goal: census.py read's census.phase row counts confirmed once per source read

run:
import argparse, collections, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import census, kbcommon
census.KB = kbcommon.KB
import factdiff
factdiff.ROOT = kbcommon.root("public")
t = collections.Counter()
census.cmd_read(argparse.Namespace(date="2026-11-09", ids=["S100", "S102"], note="n", dry_run=True), t)
print("named 2 sources; confirmed tallied", t["confirmed"])
sys.exit(0 if t["confirmed"] == 2 else 1)
